description: Reviewed technical tasks for BookCatalog modernization. Subordinate to specs/dotnet-bookcatalog-modernization.md; the specification wins on any conflict.

tasks.description: Convert BookCatalog.Web in place from ASP.NET MVC 5 on .NET Framework 4.8 with EF6 to ASP.NET Core MVC on .NET 10 with EF Core, as a single host.
tasks.requirements: Work in increments, building after each: (1) convert to an SDK-style net10.0 web project that builds and produces src/BookCatalog.Web/bin/Release/net10.0/BookCatalog.Web.dll; (2) migrate hosting, routing, controllers, views, static content, validation, antiforgery and 404 behavior; (3) replace EF6 with EF Core SqlServer using DI, deterministic seed data (seven books, seed only when empty) and migrations, against a new LocalDB database named BookCatalogModernizedLab, never dropping or recreating the database at startup; (4) remove the request User-Agent diagnostic (CH-4); detailed errors only in Development (CH-5). Preserve FR-1 to FR-9. Do not add a side-by-side host, shared schema, YARP, System.Web shims, passwords, a new test project, or Azure resources. Old MDF data is not migrated.
tasks.validation: pwsh scripts/validation/validate-dotnet-target.ps1 -EvidenceDirectory <temp dir>; baseline until the project is SDK-style: .\scripts\validation\validate-dotnet.ps1 -Configuration Release
tasks.containment: One commit per increment; revert the last increment if its build or smoke check fails.
tasks.stopConditions: Any path outside allowedPaths is needed; validation fails for reasons caused by the change; LocalDB or .NET 10 SDK missing; a secret, Azure resource or destructive action is required; the smoke script contract conflicts with the spec.
tasks.environmentConfiguration: Target framework: net10.0. .NET 10 SDK (global.json 10.0.100). Disposable LocalDB with integrated authentication.

tasks.description: Check the migrated project's package references for known vulnerabilities and use patched versions.
tasks.reason: Assessment flagged System.Data.SqlClient; the target uses Microsoft.Data.SqlClient through EF Core SqlServer.
tasks.requirements: Limit packages to ASP.NET Core MVC, EF Core SqlServer and their tooling. Record any vulnerable package, current version, patched version and breaking-change risk. Do not add packages outside the spec's dependency rule without reapproval.
tasks.validation: dotnet list legacy-src/dotnet-bookcatalog/shared-legacy-app/BookCatalog.sln package --vulnerable --include-transitive, then the primary validation command.
tasks.stopConditions: A fix needs a package outside the dependency rule or a path outside allowedPaths.

tasks.description: Verify preserved behavior locally with the repository smoke script; no new test project and no Azure.
tasks.reason: Spec acceptance criteria AC-1 to AC-8.
tasks.requirements: Run pwsh scripts/validation/validate-dotnet-target.ps1 -EvidenceDirectory <temp dir>. It must pass the smoke checks for list, create and validation, antiforgery, edit/delete and 404, and restart persistence. Then run git grep for System.Web, EntityFramework and packages.config under the source root, scan the diff for secrets, and check git diff --name-only against the spec's allowed paths. Record any check that could not run as not run.
tasks.stopConditions: Validation cannot run, or fails because of the change; the target database exists with non-synthetic data.
tasks.cleanup: Remove temp evidence directories and task-owned LocalDB smoke instances. Drop BookCatalogModernizedLab only if this task created it and only with user consent.

metadata.removedTasks: 002-setupBaseline and 003-infrastructure-azure-ready-config removed: not in the approved spec (no baseline bundle; Bicep and Azure are out of scope).
